Subject: Re: Production Server High Latency Issue - Urgent Action Required

Dear John Doe,

Thank you for bringing the production server high latency issue to our attention. We understand the urgency of this matter and its impact on our customers.

The Engineering Team has been assigned to investigate and resolve this issue promptly. They are currently working diligently to identify the root cause and implement a resolution.

We will keep you updated on our progress and expected timeline for resolution. In the meantime, please inform us if there are any specific customer requests that require immediate attention due to the latency issue.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
